parts:
Dear,

 

I’m running methylKit (methylKit_0.5.7 ) and get the following error:

       2: In is(seqnames, "Rle") : NAs introduced by coercion

       Execution halted

 

Do you have an idea what the cause is.

 

Many thanks!!

 

Best Regards / Vriendelijke Groeten / Cordialement / Freundliche Grüße

 

Cindy Martens

messages.author: 9841b724238ab59c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] error methylkit
parts:
Hi Altuna,

I am a colleague of Cindy and investigated her issue more in depth.
I found that because we are working with rather short scaffolds, our g.meth object within regionalize.R (tileMethylCounts) contains more seqname levels than there actually are. This will then cause regionCounts to be executed on chromosomes which do not exist, resulting in empty data.frames and thus NA errors.

The quickfix for our error is to replace line 336 in regionalize.R:
chrs   =IRanges::levels(seqnames(g.meth))
 by  
chrs   =unique(seqnames(g.meth))

I am no expert in the GenomicRanges package, but maybe there is also a function to drop the empty seqnames from the levels?
I hope this provides you some more insight into our error. Would you please care to update us if this is something which would be changed in a new version of the package or not?

Evelyne

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] error methylkit
parts:
OK, could you send me a subset of the data and the code that generates the error on that subset? You can send it to my private e-mail (aakalin AT gmail ) if you have data privacy issues, I can change the code as you suggested by I want to understand the error better. In the mean time, you can use your own version of tileMethylCounts() to circumvent the error. 

The problem with levels is coming from the default creation of a data frames which makes factors out of character vectors, and factor levels are carried out to GRanges coercion and becomes empty chromosome names, I will try to change that behaviour in the next version. 

Best,
Altuna

Here is a temporary fix based on what you have suggested:
https://gist.github.com/al2na/7889940

you can use the tileMethyCounts2() function in your script as follows:

library(methylKit)
source("http://rawgithub.com/al2na/7889940/raw/b9c1c067e2e6f2c1d18fb8cdaa211c78e5fe748b/tileMethylCounts2.R")

#example
data(methylKit)
tileMethylCounts2(object=methylRawList.obj,win.size=1000,step.size=1000,cov.bases=0)


let me know, if this works or not. And, the subset of the data and the code would be great to have.

Best,
Altuna
